SELECT m.MSG_ID , m.MSG_CLSF , m.TSK_CLSF_CD , m.OCCR_CLSF_CD , m.MSG_PRNT_CD , m.MSG_CN , m.USE_YN , m.REG_DTTM , m.REGR_ID , m.CHNG_DTTM , m.CHGR_ID FROM CLOVER_MSG_MNG m WHERE m.MSG_CLSF = COALESCE(#{msgClsf}, m.MSG_CLSF) AND m.TSK_CLSF_CD = COALESCE(#{tskClsfCd}, m.TSK_CLSF_CD) AND m.OCCR_CLSF_CD = COALESCE(#{occrClsfCd}, m.OCCR_CLSF_CD)
AND UPPER(m.MSG_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{msgId}) || '%'
AND UPPER(m.MSG_CN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{msgCn}) || '%'
ORDER BY m.MSG_ID LIMIT #{rowsPerPage} OFFSET #{pageNumber} * #{rowsPerPage}
